newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin declares war on crime, graft in economy.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin declares war on crime, graft in economy.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, in the first major policy statement of his second term, will launch a sweeping anti-corruption drive to restore order to the Russian economy, where graft and crime are strangling market reforms.

In his annual state of the nation address to parliament, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters on Wednesday, Yeltsin said: "The people's patience has run out." Giving no details of the government shake-up that is expected to follow Thursday's speech, he said criminal "godfathers" had challenged the state.
